description: This file defines an abstract class ContentPage within the namespace Todaymade\Daux\Format\Base, representing a generic content page with methods for setting and retrieving file, config, and content type information, as well as generating content from a file. It serves as a base class for specific page implementations.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: An abstract class providing a common interface and functionality for content pages, including managing associated file, configuration, and content type objects, and content generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the page with a title and content.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the Content object representing the file.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves the current Content file object.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the Config object for the page.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Deprecated method that sets configuration, replaced by setConfig.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the ContentType object for the page.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Generates and returns the content for the page, converting raw content if needed.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Returns the generated content; can be overridden for custom page generation.

methods.name: fromFile
methods.description: Static factory method to create a ContentPage instance from a file, configuration, and content type.
